homepageHero.alt: Marker scorecard at Shinnecock Hills with the Net Skins game active, showing hole-by-hole scores, skins winners and tied holes
homepageHero.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F1 Shinnecock scorecard through hole 9, Net Skins tab active: skins totals per player, winner labels (BAILOUT, B; EAGLE, E; SMITH, B (3)), 2 TIES and 3 TIES holes.

homepageLeaderboard.alt: Live event leaderboard for PebblePayday with an Event in progress badge and Team Stroke Play standings for four teams
homepageLeaderboard.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. Reuses event-live-leaderboard (F4 PebblePayday, in progress). Skins and Stroke Play sections collapsed; Team Stroke Play table with front, back, to-par and amount columns.

homepageGames.alt: Marker Add game screen with buttons for all twelve game formats, Premium badges on Scotch, Team Count X, Team Stableford and Wolf

Reuses game-picker (shared with eventGamesPicker and addGamesGamePicker). Twelve formats: High-Low, Match Play, Nassau, Nines (5-3-1), Skins, Scotch, Stableford, Stroke Play, Team Count X, Team Stableford, Team Stroke Play, Wolf. No per-format descriptions are shown.

tutorialCreateEventStep1.alt: Course search step of the Create event flow in Marker, with the query sp and two matching courses: Spyglass Hill GC and Spanish Bay (Links at)
tutorialCreateEventStep1.caption: Search by course name, then tap the course for your event.
tutorialCreateEventStep1.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. New-event course search; the isolated Hub's own course-search response is replayed. Query "sp", 2 matching courses.

tutorialCreateEventStep2.alt: Create event form in Marker with Spyglass Hill GC selected, no series chosen, the event name Monterey Summer Shootout, the date 07/25/2026 and a Save button
tutorialCreateEventStep2.caption: With course, name, and date filled in, tap Save to create the event.
tutorialCreateEventStep2.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. Form filled locally; Save is not pressed.

tutorialCreateEventStep3.alt: Marker event dashboard for Poppy Hills Spring Classic with empty Players (0), Scorecards and Games sections, each with an add button, and the notice Must add scorecards in order to start an event
tutorialCreateEventStep3.caption: Your event is ready — add players, scorecards, and games in any order. Marker reminds you that the event needs scorecards before it can start.
tutorialCreateEventStep3.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F5A: saved event with no players, groups or games.

eventAddPlayersPicker.alt: Event Add Players screen with three selected players shown as chips above the Recent Players list, where Debbie Dogleg, Larry Lateral and Mike Mulligan are checked, and a Continue button
eventAddPlayersPicker.caption: Check players from Recent Players — your selections collect at the top until you tap Continue.
eventAddPlayersPicker.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F5B Spyglass Club Day. Selection is local; Continue is not pressed. Vue lists Recent Players alphabetically by last name.

eventAddPlayersTees.alt: Set Player Tees step for Spyglass Hill GC with the Male tee list showing yardage, rating and slope for each tee and White checked, above a Save button
eventAddPlayersTees.caption: After Continue, set the tee for the selected players — the tees you pick apply to all of them, and individuals can be adjusted later.
eventAddPlayersTees.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. Second step after Continue (Vue: Set Player Tees). The Female tee list for Debbie Dogleg is further down the screen. Save is not pressed.

eventScorecardsTeeTimes.alt: Add Event Scorecard screen with Tee Times selected, showing Start time 08:30 AM, Start hole 1, Number of groups 4, Spacing (minutes) 10, and a Save (4) button
eventScorecardsTeeTimes.caption: For tee-time starts, set the first group's start time, starting hole, number of groups, and spacing — Marker calculates each group's tee time automatically.
eventScorecardsTeeTimes.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F5B. Save is not pressed.

eventScorecardsShotgun.alt: Add Event Scorecard screen with Shotgun Start selected, Start time 08:00 AM, Start hole 1, Number of groups 6, and the preview This will add groups starting at 08:00 AM on holes: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6
eventScorecardsShotgun.caption: For a shotgun start, Marker previews the starting holes before you save — six groups starting on hole 1 go out on holes 1 through 6.
eventScorecardsShotgun.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F5B. Start hole 1 keeps the preview exact: Vue's preview text does not wrap past hole 18, although the groups it creates do. Save is not pressed.

eventScorecardsPlayerAssignment.alt: Edit Event Scorecard screen showing the Players section with Allan Albatross, Bert Bailout, Ben Birdie and Dave Divot checked and other unassigned event players unchecked below, each with tee and course handicap
eventScorecardsPlayerAssignment.caption: Check players from the unassigned pool to add them to this scorecard — players already on other scorecards are not shown as candidates.
eventScorecardsPlayerAssignment.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F5B: nine unassigned players, one empty group. Checks are local until Save, which is not pressed.

eventGamesPicker.alt: Add game screen with buttons for all twelve game formats, Premium badges on Scotch, Team Count X, Team Stableford and Wolf
eventGamesPicker.caption: Tap any format to open its configuration — formats marked Premium require an active subscription.
eventGamesPicker.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. Reuses game-picker: Vue's event route shows the same picker (titled Add Game there).

eventGamesConfiguration.alt: Edit Game screen for an event Skins game, scrolled to Settings: Carry over skins on ties and Validate skins unchecked, Holes 1 to 18, Pool Buy-in selected at $20, and the note Winners split the pot by number of skins won
eventGamesConfiguration.caption: Skins settings: choose carryovers, validation, the holes in play, and a pool buy-in or per-skin amount. Checked players from the event roster appear above.
eventGamesConfiguration.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F4 PebblePayday Skins game (16 players); the last three checked players are visible above Settings. Save is not pressed.

eventScoringLiveLeaderboard.alt: Event leaderboard for PebblePayday with an Event in progress badge, Skins and Stroke Play collapsed, and Team Stroke Play standings for four teams with front, back, to-par and amount columns
eventScoringLiveLeaderboard.caption: Follow Event standings while groups are still playing — the Event leaderboard shows results across all teams.
eventScoringLiveLeaderboard.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F4: groups 1-3 finished, group 4 through 15. Team names within a group can appear in any order between builds.

eventCompleteConfirm.alt: Complete this event confirmation over the Marker event dashboard, explaining that completing locks the scorecards, prevents further edits and finalizes the game results, with Yes and Cancel buttons
eventCompleteConfirm.caption: Tap Complete event on the event dashboard, then Yes — Marker locks the scorecards and finalizes the game results.
eventCompleteConfirm.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F4. Opens the confirmation only; Yes is never pressed.

eventCompleteFinalSettlement.alt: Completed event leaderboard for Chambers Bay Cup with the Skins, Stroke Play and Team Stroke Play sections collapsed and Overall - event showing the Settlement view, Buy-ins collected checked, and the pot paying eight winners from $120 down to $20
eventCompleteFinalSettlement.caption: Overall - event combines every Event Game. With Buy-ins collected checked, Settlement shows what each winner receives from the pot.
eventCompleteFinalSettlement.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F7 Chambers Bay Cup, completed through Vue's Complete event. Three $10 buy-in games for 12 players ($360 pot), reconciled to the cent. Shared with commissionersSettlement.

gameNassauScorecard.alt: Marker scorecard with the Nassau tab active, showing front and total match status on each hole, automatic presses and press buttons
gameNassauScorecard.caption: Front and Total run simultaneously, while presses create additional matches from the hole where they begin.
gameNassauScorecard.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F1 Shinnecock through hole 9. Shared with followGamesNassauScorecard and scoreRoundMainScorecard.

gameNassauLeaderboard.alt: Marker Nassau leaderboard showing the Front match for holes 1 to 9 with automatic 2-down presses and their results, and the start of the Back match with 9 to play
gameNassauLeaderboard.caption: Each Nassau match has its own section. The Front shows the original match and each press with its status and result.
gameNassauLeaderboard.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F1 through hole 9. Only Front (with presses) and the start of Back are visible; Total is below the fold. Shared with followGamesLiveLeaderboard.

gameWolfPartnerModal.alt: Marker Wolf partner-selection modal on hole 6 with Allan Albatross as the Wolf, three partner choices, Lone Wolf selected, and Blind Wolf with the triples-points hint
gameWolfPartnerModal.caption: The Wolf can choose any of the other three players as a partner, play Lone Wolf, or declare Blind Wolf for triple points.
gameWolfPartnerModal.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F1. Partner button order can vary between builds.

gameSkinsScorecardCarryover.alt: Marker Skins scorecard for holes 3 to 9 with holes 5 and 6 labelled 2 TIES and 3 TIES, and Bob Smith winning hole 7 outright, labelled SMITH, B (3)
gameSkinsScorecardCarryover.caption: Tied holes show how many players tied instead of a winner. With carryovers on, the next outright winner collects the skins carried forward — SMITH, B (3) is a three-skin win.
gameSkinsScorecardCarryover.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F1 Net Skins with carryovers.

gameSkinsLeaderboard.alt: Marker Skins leaderboard with skins won and dollar results per player, and the hole-by-hole view listing each hole's low score and winner, tied holes, and Smith, B (3) on hole 7
gameSkinsLeaderboard.caption: The leaderboard shows skins won and accounting, while the hole-by-hole view shows how ties carried forward into a three-skin win.
gameSkinsLeaderboard.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F1. Rows tied on skins can appear in either order.

commissionersHero.alt: Marker event dashboard for PebblePayday with the 16-player list collapsed, four scorecards with tee times from 8:00 AM, a Republish scorecards button, and Complete event in the footer
commissionersHero.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F4 PebblePayday. Names within a group can appear in any order between builds.

followGamesNassauScorecard.alt: Nassau game selected on a Marker scorecard showing front and total match status, automatic presses and press buttons during the round
followGamesNassauScorecard.caption: Switch between game tabs to follow each game as scores are entered.
followGamesNassauScorecard.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. Reuses game-nassau-scorecard.

followGamesLiveLeaderboard.alt: Marker live leaderboard showing the Nassau Front match with its automatic presses and results, and the Back match with 9 to play

followGamesLiveLeaderboard.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. Reuses game-nassau-leaderboard.

followGamesDayTotal.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F1 in progress. Side-game settlement reconciled to the cent against every game.

reviewResultsEndRound.alt: Marker End round sheet: By ending this round, you attest that the scores are correct. This will lock the scorecard, but you can unlock it in scorecard settings.
reviewResultsEndRound.caption: Ending the round locks the scorecard and finalizes the game results. You can unlock it later in scorecard settings if a correction is needed.
reviewResultsEndRound.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F3 Cypress Point through 18. Opens the sheet only.

reviewResultsFinalSettlement.alt: Marker leaderboard after a completed round at Cypress Point Club, with Overall - side games showing the final who-pays-whom settlement: three payments between players
reviewResultsFinalSettlement.caption: After the round ends, Overall - side games shows exactly who pays whom across all games on the scorecard.
reviewResultsFinalSettlement.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F3 after End round (locked). An Upgrade to Premium banner appears at the top for this free account.

handicapsGameSettings.caption: Choose net scoring, then adjust the handicap allowance and advanced stroke settings for the game.
handicapsGameSettings.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F1 Nassau edit form with show advanced opened (display only). Save is not pressed.

handicapsScorecardIndicators.alt: Marker scorecard for holes 11 to 18 with handicap stroke dots in player score cells and a plus sign on hole 17 for a player giving a stroke back
handicapsScorecardIndicators.caption: Dots show strokes received on a hole; a plus sign shows a stroke the player gives back. Indicators follow the active game's handicap settings.
handicapsScorecardIndicators.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F1 with the Net Skins tab active (full handicaps), so Edward Eagle's plus handicap shows as + on hole 17.

gameScotchActionModal.alt: Marker Scotch hole 8 action sheet with Harry Hazard checked for Closest to Pin (KP), Match Press checked, and a Hole Press counter
gameScotchActionModal.caption: Use the Scotch hole menu to record the KP winner and add a match press or hole press during play.
gameScotchActionModal.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F2 Torrey Pines South (Vue shows the course title SOUTH). KP option order can vary between builds.

gameScotchScorecard.alt: Marker Scotch scorecard for holes 2 to 9 showing the running point differential, points per hole, KP badges, and the match press from hole 8 marked 2x
gameScotchScorecard.caption: The Scotch column tracks the running point differential and each hole's points. KP badges mark the closest-to-pin winners, and the match press from hole 8 doubles points for the rest of the match (2x).
gameScotchScorecard.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F2. Running total climbs to +15 by hole 7; hole 8 shows 10 points with 2x (match).

gameMatchPlayScorecard.alt: Marker Match Play scorecard (tab labelled Matchplay: 1 - 18) showing the original match and concurrent presses, including an automatic press from hole 4
gameMatchPlayScorecard.caption: The original match and each press run independently. Automatic presses begin new matches when a side falls two down, while manual presses remain available during play.
gameMatchPlayScorecard.notes: Vue capture from the production Vue app (pinned commit d6225d5) against isolated fictional fixture data; approved Oct 2026. No personal data. F2. Vue labels the tab Matchplay and the column Match Play.
